definition: Gate valve / generic two-way valve (plain bowtie)
Globe valve (bowtie with a dot at the waist)
Stop-check valve (check valve with a stem, manual or powered)
Spring safety or relief valve (the symbol does not tell safety from relief; the tag does)
Pilot-operated safety relief valve and its pilot (POSRV, PORV)
Damper with no operator drawn (parallel blade, gravity, fire damper, ...)
Centrifugal pump (incl. horizontal centrifugal); the driver is the actuator
Air handling unit / cubicle cooler housing
Filter (piping filter, prefilter, postfilter, HEPA filter)
Spray: spray nozzle, spray header, sparger
Instrument (bubble or box with a tag)
Diesel engine / prime mover drawn on its own
Containment penetration (box on the containment boundary, e.g. 'PC')
Labelled equipment block (named by its text)
